// why: Configuration for the TypeScript files sitting at the repository root — today `vitest.config.ts` and `vitest.workspace.ts`. They belong to no library and no application, so until recently NO compiler saw them: `req-quality-typecheck` promises there is no such code in the workspace (lesson-42). The name is `tsconfig.root.json` and not `tsconfig.json`, because a file under the latter name at the root takes over the whole repository in the editor and in every tool that searches up the tree.
// include: A pattern, not a list of names: a file added at the root should come under the compiler by itself. The single star is deliberate — it covers the root alone, so `tools/foo.ts` does NOT slip in here quietly; it fires `check-typecheck` and forces a decision about which project it belongs to.
